top root/tb.shbench for Ngspice
== root/cap.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix C
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem root/cap.sym"
  xfp 8dc98d88fbd7ee9b

pin A inout 0 -30
pin B inout 0 30

param C 1p

impl spice spice
  format spice "{name} {A} {B} {C}"

line 0 -30 0 -4
  layer 4
line 0 4 0 30
  layer 4
line -12 -4 12 -4
  layer 4
line -12 4 12 4
  layer 4

stext 16 -12 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
  layer 3
stext 16 2 R0 C=
  size 0.18
  layer 3
== root/res.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix R
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem root/res.sym"
  xfp 9795c6304861d25d

pin A inout 0 -30
pin B inout 0 30

param R 1k

impl spice spice
  format spice "{name} {A} {B} {R}"

line 0 -30 0 -15
  layer 4
line 0 15 0 30
  layer 4

rect -5 -15 5 15
  layer 4
  fill false

stext 10 -12 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
  layer 3
stext 10 2 R0 R=
  size 0.18
  layer 3
== root/tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  provenance "xschem root/tb.sch"
  xfp e68b33b6b8f33212

inst nmsaab ./cap
  at 0 90 R0
  name C1
  C C
inst wd97eg ./res
  at 0 0 R0
  name R1
  R R

wire h123f1 0 30 0 60

label d5d493 0 -30 R0 in
label djz6at 0 120 R0 0
label jzc32a 0 30 R0 out

text j2yqx6 -60 -80 R0 "RC low-pass: V1 in 0 1 (code block), tau = R C"
  size 0.3

var R 3.3k
var C 1u

code params spice
code tran spice
  | V1 in 0 1
  | .ic v(out)=0
  | .op
  | .tran 1u 5m 0 1u uic
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project

lib root path root
